title: P1: handoff.py missing expiry validation in COSE request
description:
File: python/src/lichen/gateway/handoff.py
Lines: 667, 690-712

HandoffRequestCosePayload has an 'expiry' field (line 667) specifying when the request expires, but nothing validates that current_time < expiry:
- from_cbor() parses expiry but doesn't check it
- HandoffRequestCoseSign1.verify() checks signature but not expiry
- No caller in this module validates expiry

This allows replay of captured handoff requests after their intended expiry time, bypassing the time-limited validity that expiry is meant to enforce.

Fix: Add expiry validation in verify() or create a validate_request() method that checks:
1. ts <= current_time (request not from future)
2. current_time < expiry (request not expired)

SECURITY: Enables replay attacks on handoff protocol.
